related.title: 海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場
related.transfer: 可遷移「轉子推力與塔基彎矩」與「疲勞循環數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Rotor thrust and tower-base moment" and "Number of fatigue cycles" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Formosa Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦超大型水下基礎的製造：單樁的質量與徑厚比、厚板銲接的工時與打樁能量；海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場則以臺灣首批商轉離岸風場：颱風等級風機、導管架基礎與不設離岸變電站的 66 kV 送電為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on making very large underwater foundations: mass and diameter-to-thickness ratio of monopiles, hours of thick-plate welding and piling energy; Formosa Offshore Wind Farm centres on taiwan's first commercial offshore wind farms: typhoon-class turbines, jacket foundations and 66 kV export with no offshore substation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「掃掠面積與比功率」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「徑厚比與挫屈」的模型移到海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「海上安裝的天氣窗」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Swept area and specific power" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Diameter-to-thickness ratio and buckling" to Formosa Offshore Wind Farm, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Weather windows for offshore installation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「轉子推力與塔基彎矩」與「疲勞循環數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Rotor thrust and tower-base moment" and "Number of fatigue cycles" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Formosa Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.

related.title: 陸域風機塔筒與基礎耦合
related.titleEn: Onshore Wind Turbine Tower and Foundation Coupling
related.transfer: 可遷移「轉子推力與塔基彎矩」與「疲勞循環數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；陸域風機塔筒與基礎耦合的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Rotor thrust and tower-base moment" and "Number of fatigue cycles" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Onshore Wind Turbine Tower and Foundation Coupling must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦超大型水下基礎的製造：單樁的質量與徑厚比、厚板銲接的工時與打樁能量；陸域風機塔筒與基礎耦合則以陸域風機的支撐結構：塔筒壁應力與運輸限制、重力式基礎的偏心與錨栓拉力為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on making very large underwater foundations: mass and diameter-to-thickness ratio of monopiles, hours of thick-plate welding and piling energy; Onshore Wind Turbine Tower and Foundation Coupling centres on support structure of an onshore turbine: tower-wall stress and transport limits, eccentricity of a gravity foundation and anchor-bolt tension, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「掃掠面積與比功率」與「掃掠面積與比功率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「徑厚比與挫屈」的模型移到陸域風機塔筒與基礎耦合，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「風速誤差與功率不確定度」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Swept area and specific power" and "Swept area and specific power".
Move the model of "Diameter-to-thickness ratio and buckling" to Onshore Wind Turbine Tower and Foundation Coupling, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wind-speed error and power uncertainty", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「轉子推力與塔基彎矩」與「疲勞循環數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；陸域風機塔筒與基礎耦合的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Rotor thrust and tower-base moment" and "Number of fatigue cycles" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Onshore Wind Turbine Tower and Foundation Coupling must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: XXL 單樁與導管架基礎製造
history.titleEn: XXL Monopile and Jacket Foundation Fabrication
history.text: 1991 年首座離岸風場採重力式基礎；2002 年直徑約 4 m 的單樁用於大型風場；2016 年直徑超過 8 m 的超大型單樁問世；2023 年直徑超過 11 m 的單樁開始製造。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1991: The first offshore wind farm used gravity foundations. 2002: Monopiles about 4 m in diameter were used at a large farm. 2016: Extra-large monopiles over 8 m in diameter appeared. 2023: Monopiles over 11 m in diameter entered fabrication. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
